about_the_game:
About the Demo

It's Demo Day at the Pan-Galactic Postal Service, giving you and your team a chance to deliver parcels to Delivery Zone 1 on the toroidal megastructure called Ringville! Yes, it's a free chance to experience the parcel delivery experience (while your future supervisors take notes about things like teamwork, resiliency, and likelihood to unionize). 

This demo version of Mailstrom allows your team full access to Zone 1, but tensor fields will prevent you from traveling beyond the zone's perimeter. You can do as many runs as you'd like, at any difficulty you'd like. Higher difficulties will provide you with greater challenges to overcome, but will also pay bigger dividends! Spend the money your team earns at the Postal Supplies shop, where Rank 1 items can be purchased. 

About Mailstrom

Neither rain, nor snow, nor galactic apocalypse can keep the Pan Galactic Postal Service from their appointed rounds! Join a 4-player co-op team of sci-fi letter carriers to deliver parcels to a variety of unappreciative recipients across the galaxy.

Essential Workers Only

Be careful! Interdimensional rifts have unleashed otherworldly alien horrors across the Hegemon, and only essential workers are allowed on the streets. That means YOU!

Team Up with Friends

Play solo or with up to four friends in online multiplayer co-op. Seek out delivery destinations, pick up outgoing mail, and blast through waves of rapacious alien monsters as you meet your delivery quotas and earn money that you can use to buy new items and weapons!

What Happens in Mailstrom...

Out of ammo? Feel free to open any parcel and use whatever you find to defend yourself! Sure, it's illegal - but we won't tell!

Features

Mailstrom allows up to 4 players to team up in a fast-paced FPS where finding delivery addresses is as big a challenge as staying alive! Help one another as much as you can by carrying different items that can be used to defeat enemies, increase deliveries, and figure out where the heck you're supposed to go!

  • Team up with up to three friends in chaotic online co-op, or brave the apocalypse solo

  • Experience endless variety with procedurally randomized streets, obstacles, and delivery locations

  • Coordinate loadouts with teammates—carry different items to maximize survival and efficiency

  • Progress through increasingly challenging delivery routes with escalating pay and rewards

  • Upgrade your postal arsenal with earnings from successful deliveries

And Remember: The best way to improve your pay is to improve your performance, NOT to join a costly and unhelpful union!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD @ 2 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 4GB or AMD RX 580 4GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD @ 3 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 8GB or AMD RX 5700 XT 8GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Join a co-op team of 4 friends in a first person shooter that sends Pan Galactic Postal Service letter carriers into the locked-down streets of the future! Fight mutated alien horrors as you and your fellow essential workers deliver baubles to hard-to-find destinations! Hey, at least it's a job!
